correctness.rationale: Enumerating all 2^16 independent vertex masks gives 743 faces including empty, with exactly 367 acyclic Morse pairs and one vertex plus seven 3-cells critical, so Ind(Q4)≃∨7S3. The reduced signed face Lefschetz trace agrees for every element with sgn(σ)[f(σ)−1+sum_fixed_i (−1)^{sum_{j≠i}b_j}]; character semisimplicity identifies sgn⊗(U⊕P3), and its translation Fourier invariants have ranks 3 (translation subgroup) and 0 (full group). Rational quotient homology is the invariant subspace. Character is over Q only, not integral equivariant splitting.
